messages.content: Write only C# statements for an existing PicoGK.Lattice named lattice. Use lattice.AddBeam(new Vector3(xf, yf, zf), radiusf, new Vector3(xf, yf, zf), radiusf, true/false); with numeric literals. No declarations, loops, comments, Markdown or other APIs. Coordinates are designed millimeters, not measured engine dimensions. Return one statement per edge.

Build a synthetic graph. Vertices in mm: {"A": [-14, -8, 0], "B": [-14, 8, 12], "C": [14, -8, 12], "D": [14, 8, 0]}. Directed edges: A->B, A->C, A->D, B->C, B->D, C->D. Each edge has start diameter 3 mm and end diameter 5 mm. Rounded caps: true. Convert diameters to radii. Emit every edge exactly once.

motivation: Synthetic nonplanar tapered truss inspired by structural-carrier studies; not a reconstruction of 993-ENG-CARRIER-0001
